bounded_host_request.command:
cd /home/admin1/server-core || exit 1
bits=
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 7fede271a9459b998935e1ae9995d7feba27d9c5 && bits="${bits}1" || bits="${bits}0"
test "$(git hash-object scripts/servercore_service_deploy_socket.py)" = 81265fddb888af92a1c45ad89a9467ead6e996e7 && bits="${bits}1" || bits="${bits}0"
test "$(git hash-object scripts/servercore_bounded_host_receiver.py)" = 99b7aee32962348085f6d4051f6c56ee929c8b28 && bits="${bits}1" || bits="${bits}0"
systemctl --user is-active --quiet gace-servercore-service-deploy.service && bits="${bits}1" || bits="${bits}0"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' server-core-bounded-host 2>/dev/null)" = true && bits="${bits}1" || bits="${bits}0"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' server-core-bounded-host 2>/dev/null)" = healthy && bits="${bits}1" || bits="${bits}0"
printf '%s\n' "$bits"
